race.comment: The feature race on the card, the $100,000 Newmarket. TAMBO'S JUSTICE (5) is going well this preparation, including a last start win over 1300m at Townsville to bring up two wins from three runs in the campaign. Should camp just off the leaders and his best figures should see him run well. DEMON AWARD (2) ran below expectations last time at Townsville over 1300m, finishing sixth and beaten 3 lengths. Should park just off the speed. Will play a major role. ODEGAARD (13) was sent out favourite but could only finish seventh over 2000m at Townsville last time. Prior to that had been racing well, collecting two minor placings on end. Backmarker who gets home hard and will be picking them up late. VALENKI (11) hasn't been far away lately, last time out finishing just 2.5 lengths back in fifth over 1300m at Townsville. Form at this track is hard to knock with four wins from 12 starts. Too good to ignore.
